name: FUN_SITUATION_CONTEXTS
description: This table contains Oracle Fusion applications situation contexts. A situation is generated in Oracle Process Automation when an Oracle Fusion application specific business object information is requested for the situation. A record is generated in this table to map the situation and the application business object.

columns.name: SITUATION_CONTEXT_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for identifying a situation context transaction.

columns.name: SITUATION_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for a situation that is generated in Oracle Process Automation

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Object type that identifies Oracle Fusion applications business object category.

columns.name: OBJECT_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Unique identifier for the Oracle Fusion applications business object.

columns.name: OBJECT_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: Object Identifier to display Oracle Fusion applications object to user

columns.name: OBJECT_DEEPLINK_URL
columns.description: Deeplink URL to access Oracle Fusion applications business object.

columns.name: OBJECT_CONTEXT_METADATA
columns.description: Captures object context metadata information for a specific situation.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
